limitations: Numeric bounds, date checks and fixture parity do not prove that every historical source value was transcribed correctly.
Stored ingested_at is last write time, not an immutable first-publication or event-time record.
Historical series begin at different dates. A 2019 policy window does not imply complete observations since 2019.
Repeated same-day rows can represent timestamp migrations or revisions. Canonical baseline selection uses one reference day; contradictions remain listed for review.

reviewedFindings.finding: Two breakeven bound flags describe one negative reference-day observation, not two independent errors.
reviewedFindings.resolution: Official BoE IUDSNZC minus IUDSIZC for 1 August 2024 is -0.03139999999999965. The stored canonical value matches and is retained. The operational lower plausibility guard now allows negative breakevens down to -2; the upper bound 8 and daily-jump protection 0.8 are unchanged. This does not alter scoring polarity or weights.

reviewedFindings.finding: 130 reference-day contradictions remain in legacy gilt representations.
reviewedFindings.resolution: All selected canonical gilt observations now match the official 10-year/20-year series. Older midnight values remain visible in raw history, excluded by the one-reference-day baseline selection.

reviewedFindings.finding: FTSE 250 on 26 August 2026 differs between the stored live value (24961.9) and the curated Yahoo history proxy (24898).
reviewedFindings.resolution: Unresolved provider/session discrepancy. Yahoo returned HTTP 429 during verification. Neither value was silently overwritten; the discrepancy remains disclosed.

onsVintagePolicy: Current heads are refreshed from current official primary series. Older ONS observations retain their previously recorded source vintages; later revisions are reported, not silently mass-overwritten. Direct-debit curated history rounds to one decimal while current live values keep source precision. Differences against today's revised API are not automatically transcription errors. updateDate is revision metadata, not proof of first publication.
